preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
Length of each string s is between 2 and 10^6.
Number of queries q is between 1 and 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: for each query: 1 <= l < r <= len(s)
preconditions.description: Query indices l and r are within the bounds of the string s.
The length of the substring s[l:r+1] is even.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: for each query: output is an integer x >= 0
postconditions.description: The output for each query is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.
